headline: Customer support is still the top complaint, ahead of late delivery.
comparison_note: Against October 2026 (from the October report): average rating 4.00 vs 3.98, 1-star share 18.6% vs 18.7%. Ratings are flat, but replies improved, with 1-star reply coverage up from 39.1% to 51.4%. This is a partial month, 13 days.
release_note: Version 20.0.0 stands out, with a 1-star share well above the period's, though on only 129 reviews. The two main versions, 19.9.9 and 20.0.1, sit close to the average. Reviews with no app version are the usual outlier.
asks_heading: Three asks for the rest of November

actions.title: Fix how tickets get closed
actions.text: Support comes up in [[complaints.share@code=support|pct]] of written complaints, the top theme for a second period. Audit a sample of closed tickets for real resolution.
